source_quote: Fulfilling the following admission requirements does not guarantee admission to a
answer: Meeting the admission requirements does not guarantee admission; it only places the applicant in the competition pool. Admission is competitive and subject to available spaces in the desired program.

source_quote: Applicants to RHU must satisfy the following basic requirements: (1) attained the
answer: Applicants must: (1) have the prerequisite education for the program; (2) not have been expelled from another institution for academic or misconduct reasons; (3) submit the application form and materials by the deadlines and pay the application fee; (4) submit all required certified documents; and (5) for non-Lebanese applicants, provide copies of passport and residence permit.

source_quote: Students may register for their courses after completing all RHU admission
answer: Students may register for courses only after completing all RHU admission requirements.

source_quote: To be admitted, the student must have completed at least 12 years of schooling before
answer: To be admitted, a student must have completed at least 12 years of schooling and provide proof of English-language proficiency.

source_quote: Arts and Sciences General and Life Sciences, Sociology & Economics*,
answer: Lebanese Baccalaureate tracks accepted: Arts and Sciences - General and Life Sciences, Sociology & Economics, Humanities & Literature; Business Administration - General and Life Sciences, Sociology & Economics, Humanities & Literature; Engineering - General and Life Sciences, Sociology & Economics (with conditions noted for some tracks).

source_quote: Sociology & Economics track students must take two remedial Math courses as a
answer: Sociology & Economics track students must take two remedial Math courses to join Computer Science, or four remedial courses (two Math and two Physics) to join any Engineering program, provided that grade 11 was in the scientific track.

source_quote: ** Humanities and Literature track students can enroll in all majors offered by the
answer: Humanities and Literature track students can enroll in all College of Arts and Sciences majors except Computer Science, and must take one remedial Math course to be admitted to Business Administration.

source_quote: Lebanese Technical Baccalaureate. Students with a Technical Baccalaureate
answer: Technical Baccalaureate holders may pursue a degree in a major corresponding to their technical specialization, as stipulated by Ministry of Higher Education Decree #779/M/2013, and must complete the specified remedial courses.

source_quote: Engineering All majors • Mathematics (6 credits)
answer: Technical Baccalaureate remedial courses: Computer Science - Mathematics 6, Physics 3, Chemistry 3 credits; Business Administration (all majors) - Mathematics 3, Statistics 3, Economics 3 credits; Engineering (all majors) - Mathematics 6, Physics 6, Chemistry 3 credits.

source_quote: Foreign Secondary Level Certificate. Holders of a foreign certificate equivalent to the
answer: Holders of a foreign certificate equivalent to the Lebanese Official High School diploma (e.g., Official Secondary Certificate from Arab countries, French Baccalaureate, International Baccalaureate, German Abitur) may enroll in an appropriate program if the Ministry of Education validates the certificate.

source_quote: High School Diploma. A student who holds a High School Diploma (American system)
answer: An American-system High School Diploma holder may be admitted to the freshman program if: (1) they completed 12 years of study; (2) the certificate is recognized by authorities in the country of origin; and (3) they provide a certified copy of permission to join the Freshman Program from the Equivalence Committee of the Lebanese Ministry of Higher Education.

source_quote: General Certificate of Education (GCE). An applicant with a British Certificate may be
answer: A British GCE holder may enter the freshman program with 5 Ordinary Level courses, 1 Advanced Level, and 12 years of study. Applicants with at least five O-Level and three A-Level subjects, or six AS subjects (excluding languages), can be admitted to the sophomore program.

source_quote: Students are required to provide evidence of English language proficiency and college-
answer: Students must show English proficiency and college-level skills through standardized tests such as TOEFL or SAT or by taking RHU placement exams; all three colleges require the English placement exam. Depending on performance, students may be required to take remedial courses.

source_quote: Entrance Exam with a minimum score of 380 or by achieving a minimum score on
answer: Applicants must demonstrate English proficiency by passing the RHU English Entrance Exam with a minimum score of 380, or by meeting minimum scores on standardized English exams.

source_quote: Institutional TOEFL (ITP)/ RHU In-House TOEFL 550
answer: Minimum standardized English scores: Institutional TOEFL (ITP)/RHU In-House TOEFL 550; Internet-Based TOEFL (IBT) 80; IELTS 6.5; SAT Reading & Writing Evidence-Based 530+.

source_quote: Students who fail to attain the requisite score must enroll in the Intensive English
answer: Students who do not reach the required English score must enroll in the Intensive English Program (IELP), which has three levels; students are placed at the appropriate level based on their English proficiency exam score.

source_quote: RHU recognizes an Institutional TOEFL score as valid for one year from the test date.
answer: An Institutional TOEFL score is valid for one year from the test date, while IBT, SAT, and IELTS scores are valid for two years.

source_quote: Apply online: https://www.rhu.edu.lb/apply
answer: Apply in person at the Admissions Office (Rafik Hariri University, Block E, Mechref Village, Damour, Lebanon) or online at https://www.rhu.edu.lb/apply.

source_quote: Original grades of the last three high school years.
answer: Required officially certified documents: original grades of the last three high school years; certified copy of the high school certificate/diploma; certified Lebanese Baccalaureate equivalency for non-Lebanese diplomas; English proficiency exam scores; civil status record (Lebanese) or passport and residence permit copies (non-Lebanese); three identical recent colored passport photos; copy of the Lebanese identity card; and the application fee.

source_quote: A non-refundable application fee of USD 30 is paid in cash at the RHU Finance
answer: The undergraduate application fee is USD 30 (non-refundable) and is paid in cash at the RHU Finance Office or any BankMed branch.

source_quote: Provide a certified copy of Permission from the Equivalence Committee of the
answer: Freshman program applicants must also provide a certified copy of permission from the Equivalence Committee of the Lebanese Ministry of Education to join the Foreign Program/Freshman class and submit SAT or ACT aptitude test scores before enrolling.

source_quote: SAT-Scholastic Aptitude Test 870 950
answer: Minimum aptitude test scores for the freshman program: SAT 870 (Freshman Arts) or 950 (Freshman Sciences); ACT 15 (Freshman Arts) or 17 (Freshman Sciences).

source_quote: Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC)
answer: If the student's school is accredited by WASC, SACS, AdvancED (Cognia), NEASC, NCASC, NACS, or the Council of International Schools, the freshman requirements suffice for sophomore admission after completing the Freshman Program and obtaining the equivalency from the Lebanese Ministry of Higher Education.

source_quote: Subject Tests during your first year at RHU and before you can start your
answer: Students from schools not accredited by the listed boards must also take ACT Subject Tests during their first year at RHU before starting sophomore year: Mathematics I plus any two subjects (Freshman Arts, minimum total 51 with at least 15 per subject) or Mathematics II plus two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics (Freshman Sciences, minimum total 60 with at least 17 per subject).

source_quote: Lebanese students cannot declare a major and join the sophomore class until they
answer: Lebanese students cannot declare a major and join the sophomore class until they satisfy the requirements of the Lebanese Ministry of Education and Higher Education and of the RHU freshman program.

source_quote: Has studied at least one semester in the old institution and has good academic
answer: A student at an accredited full-time institution may be admitted as a transfer if space is available and they: studied at least one semester there with good academic standing; were not dismissed for disciplinary reasons; and satisfy the admission requirements of the desired program.

source_quote: A transfer student must submit official transcripts attested by the Ministry of Higher
answer: Transfer students must submit official transcripts attested by the Ministry of Higher Education in the country of origin and a certified copy of detailed course descriptions; students transferring from outside Lebanon must also submit a letter of accreditation from the Lebanese Ministry of Higher Education.

source_quote: for disciplinary reasons, the acceptance will be revoked retroactively.
answer: If it is later discovered that a transfer student was dismissed from their former university for disciplinary reasons, their acceptance is revoked retroactively.

source_quote: The Admission Committee of the concerned College reviews the transfer applications.
answer: The Admission Committee of the concerned college reviews transfer applications and sends recommendations to the Dean, who informs the Director of Admission of the final decision.

source_quote: regular semesters at RHU for a three-year program or four regular semesters for a four-
answer: Transfer students are treated as new students for probation and dismissal. To earn a bachelor's degree they must study at least three regular semesters at RHU for a three-year program, or four for a four-year program, and acquire Co-op work experience; a regular semester equals a minimum of 12 earned credits for transfer purposes.

source_quote: a. The student has attained a minimum Cumulative GPA of 70% or its equivalent, and
answer: Transferred courses count as RHU credits if: the student has a cumulative GPA of at least 70% and a course grade of 75 or above; the course is equivalent (at least 80% content match, same components, same or more credits); the credits were earned within three years of the transfer date; and the student completes at least half of the bachelor's credit requirements at RHU.

source_quote: A “P” grade shall appear on the student's record for each transferred course but will not
answer: Each transferred course appears with a 'P' grade on the student's record and is not included in the cumulative GPA. If a student also takes the equivalent RHU course, either the transferred course or the RHU course, with its grade, appears on the transcript.

source_quote: Visiting student status allows students actively pursuing a degree at another college or
answer: Visiting student status lets students pursuing a degree elsewhere take RHU courses and transfer credits home. Requirements: good academic standing (minimum CGPA 70%) from a university recognized by RHU, and English proficiency (TOEFL-IBT 65+, IELTS 5.5-6+, or RHU in-house TOEFL 514), which may be waived for applicants from English-medium institutions.

source_quote: Submit written permission from the home institution for the courses to be taken at
answer: Visiting students submit an application form (non-refundable fee), an official transcript, written permission from the home institution for the courses, three passport photos and a copy of ID, and pay a non-refundable reservation deposit (applied to tuition) upon acceptance.

source_quote: Students must have a high school leaving certificate or higher level of education
answer: Non-degree students (with a recognized secondary diploma or university degree) can take specific courses for academic credit. They need a recognized high school leaving certificate or higher, English proficiency (TOEFL-IBT 65+, IELTS 5.5-6+, or RHU in-house TOEFL 514, waivable for English-medium institutions), an application form and fee, transcript/diploma, three photos, ID copy, and a non-refundable reservation deposit applied to tuition.

source_quote: Admission to RHU as a visiting or non-degree student doesn’t guarantee admission to
answer: Visiting or non-degree admission does not guarantee admission to a regular degree program. Credits taken may count toward an RHU degree only if the student reapplies as a regular student and is accepted.

source_quote: Individuals wishing to attend classes without receiving academic credit may enroll at
answer: Auditors attend classes without academic credit. They submit an application form, a non-refundable application fee, a passport-size photo, a copy of ID, and a non-refundable reservation deposit that applies toward tuition.

source_quote: Students may wish to pursue a degree at RHU part-time, taking less than the full load of
answer: Students may study part-time (less than the full load of 12 credits per semester) provided the maximum duration for the degree is not exceeded; they may be required to enroll full-time for some semesters to finish within the allowed period.

source_quote: Admission to any graduate program at RHU is based on merit. It is offered to applicants
answer: Graduate admission is merit-based for holders of undergraduate degrees from RHU or other accredited institutions; students can apply for fall or spring, and details are in the Graduate Catalog.

source_quote: The Board of Trustees determines the University's tuition and fees annually. Tuition and
answer: The Board of Trustees sets RHU tuition and fees annually; tuition and fees may increase annually without prior notice.

answer: The NSSF subscription is LBP 8,400,000, an annual fee payable by Lebanese students who are not registered with the NSSF.

answer: Tuition payments are scheduled over four installments in fall and spring and two installments in summer; the deferred payment fee is USD 20 per semester.

answer: The optional regular shuttle costs USD 480 per semester (deferred over two installments) and USD 240 per summer session. Routes: Beirut-RHU, Saida-RHU (Mokhtara-RHU and Iqlim-RHU when applicable). It is non-refundable from week two.

source_quote: Per semester Car/Motorbike 80/20

source_quote: 7 Dorm Deposit Fee: Refunded to the student upon the decision to leave the facility and only when
